in_sanskrit.name: Ganesha
in_sanskrit.meaning: The One Who Causes Obstacles to be Removed
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Vinayaka, the remover of obstacles, is a popular Hindu deity. He is the god of wisdom, knowledge, new beginnings, and the destroyer of obstacles, both literal and metaphorical, as well as the lord of arts and sciences.

in_telugu.name: శయజ్యోదేశ
in_telugu.meaning: The Master of the Mountain (Shiva) and the Lord of the Obstacles

in_marathi.name: Ganesha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ganesha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ganesha is the deity with the head of an elephant, the god of wisdom, the remover of obstacles, the deity honored at the start of any new venture or at the beginning of a journey.

in_bengali.name: Ganesha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Elephant-headed god
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ganesha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Ganesha is the deity with the head of an elephant, the god of wisdom, the remover of obstacles, the deity honored at the start of any new venture or at the beginning of a journey.
